## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make test-race` (or explain why it was not run)
- [ ] Frontend bundle regenerated when `internal/web/static/src/` changed
- [ ] Documentation and screenshots updated where the behavior changed

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] I considered authentication, secrets, filesystem effects, and command execution
- [ ] I considered database migration and backward-compatibility effects
